🚀 TSL Learning Path

Learn WebGPU compute shaders with Three.js TSL, step by step

Fundamentals

1Hello Compute

Your first GPU compute shader. Learn the basic structure: buffers, instanceIndex, and compute().

instancedArray instanceIndex Fn() .compute()
2Vectors and Math

Working with vec2, vec3, vec4. Math operations, swizzling, and computing distances.

vec3 .add() .sub() .mul() .length() .xyz swizzling
3Conditionals (If/Else)

Branching logic in TSL. Comparison operators and the If/ElseIf/Else syntax.

If() .greaterThan() .and() .or() .toVar()
4Atomic Operations

Thread-safe operations for parallel programming. Essential for accumulating results.

atomicAdd atomicStore struct race conditions
5Parallel Filter Pattern

The key pattern: test items in parallel, output only those that pass. Uses atomicAdd for indexing.

parallel filter atomicAdd for slots output compaction

Geometry

6Geometry Test: Point in Triangle

Apply TSL to actual geometry. Test if 2D points are inside a triangle using cross products.

cross product point-in-triangle select()

Coming Soon

7Line-Triangle Intersection

Test if a line segment intersects a triangle. Foundation for edge clipping.

plane intersection barycentric coords
8Putting It Together: Edge Clipping

Combine everything: parallel filter + geometry tests = GPU edge clipping!

edge-triangle overlap projection
